desc: Read the input values for N, sequence A, sequence B, and sequence C.
Iterate through each index i from 0 to N-1.
Check if A_i is different from B_i.
If they differ, add the cost to the total: if A_i is 1, add C_i; if A_i is 0, add 0.

Implement the solution in Python: read inputs, calculate initial weighted sum, separate indices into lists U (flip 1->0) and V (flip 0->1), sort U descending and V ascending, then simulate the operations to compute the minimum total cost.
